items.text: One €43m grant, closing 31 March; consortia are forming now.

items.title: Damping and nonlinear transfer coupled in one kinetic equation
items.text: Ransome, Alberello and Proment derive it; total dissipation barely changes, but energy shifts noticeably between frequencies, especially under weak damping.

items.title: DeepONet surrogate for SWAN bulk wave parameters
items.text: Four orders of magnitude faster at Duck, NC, with significant wave height within 1.9% on unseen cases.
